description: An action triggered by mouse, touch or keyboard, with progress and result states.

howToUse: Write the label as the action it performs, with a verb: "Save changes", "Send invite".
Keep one `primary` button per area. Other actions in the same area use `secondary` or `ghost`.
Use `danger` only for an action that deletes or cannot be undone, and confirm it first with AlertDialog.
While the action runs, set `loading` (or `status="loading"`): the button shows progress and ignores new clicks. Use `status="success"` or `"error"` to show the result in the button itself.
Use `block` in narrow columns and on mobile, where the button takes the full width.
alternatives: Going to another page: Button with `href`, which renders a link, or NavCard.
An action with only an icon: IconButton.
Several actions grouped under one: SplitButton or Menu.

keyboard.action: Moves focus to the button. A disabled button is skipped.
Runs the action. Nothing happens while it is loading.

props.name: variant
props.description: Visual hierarchy. Primary uses the text set by the on-primary token.

props.name: appearance
props.description: Web: `field` makes the button read as a field (search, picker), with field background and text.

props.name: href
props.description: With `href`, the button is a link (`<a>`) with the same look. Disabled or loading, it goes back to being a button.

props.name: target
props.description: Link target when there is an `href`.

props.name: rel
props.description: Link `rel`; with `target="_blank"` the default is `noreferrer`.

props.name: interactionState
props.description: Visual preview of a linked gesture; it does not click or change disabled.

props.name: size
props.description: Size variant.

props.name: leadingIcon
props.description: Icon to the left of the label (16px recommended).

props.name: trailingIcon
props.description: Icon to the right of the label.

props.name: loading
props.description: Shows a spinner and blocks clicks.

props.name: status
props.description: Explicit state to show completion or error; `loading` stays compatible.

props.name: progressEffect
props.description: Loading: spinner, fill or line. Older spin/shrink options use the line without hiding the label.

props.name: loadingLabel
props.description: Accessible/visible label while processing.

props.name: block
props.description: Takes 100% of the container width.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Disables interaction.

props.name: value
props.description: Value in controlled state.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: Initial value in uncontrolled state.

props.name: className
props.description: Extra CSS class.

props.name: style
props.description: The component's inline styles.

props.name: aria-label
props.description: Defines a string value that labels the current element.

props.name: children
props.description: Content shown by the component.

props.name: onChange
props.description: Callback called when the value changes.

props.name: onClick
props.description: Activation callback.
